review_protocol.required_reviewer_role: lineage reviewer with evidence analyst support
review_protocol.completion_evidence: completed required_evidence fields, source ownership decision, outcome linkage decision, rights note, and signed disposition
review_protocol.promotion_boundary: No claim or finding is promoted from this queue without a recorded independent outcome or an explicit held disposition.

next_action: Assign the first high-priority claims to a lineage reviewer, resolve ownership and underlying-dataset dependence, then acquire dated independent outcome measures before any IBIS finding promotion.
boundary: This queue identifies candidates for manual review; it does not establish independence, validate outcomes, clear rights, or authorize an internal company bridge.
